[b]An Naba News[/b]

[u]Coup Plot Foiled, Plotters Arrested[/u]

24 DHUL HIJJAH 

Medinat al-Islam - A group of four colonels, two sergeants, and a captain in the army were arrested in the General Staff HQ early Saturday morning after their plot to overthrow the government and establish an Arab nationalist military regime were revealed by a former plotter who turned against the group. They are now waiting for their military tribunal, which are to be held in the coming week according to the government.

The treasonous military plot against the Sultanate has been foiled, all thanks are to Allah said Sultan Masud al-Ayyubi at a press conference. It seems that these ambitious young men were inspired by recent coups in other parts of Shamat. We have not found any evidence of foreign involvement, however. Our message to these plotters and other would-be putschists is simple: such things have a very slim chance of working here, and the consequences may be severe. As for the fate of the coup plotters, this will be decided by the military courts soon, in shaa Allah. 

If it is decided that this constitutes treason, however, the punishment is death. Let this be a warning for those who seek to impose themselves on our glorious nation by such devious and cynical means. May Allah swt keep Baladullah under His rule.

[spoiler=The Expansion Claims][i][b]The Expansion of the Oceanice Republic (1910-1915)[/b]

The years 1910-1915 were eventful years in the history of the Oceanic Republic, during which there was an attempt to gain more land. Driven by national pride and fascism, the Republic looked to expand its power both southwards and northwards. This era of land conquest reshaped the borders of the Republic and also had long-term effects on its people, economy, and government.
Southern Expansion and the Distant Islands

The strategically located and resource-endowed southern provinces were a prime target of the Oceanice Republic's expansionist thrust. Forays were conducted to seize the outlying southern islands, as the promise of fertile lands and rich sea resources beckoned settlers and military alike. Central to this expansion was the establishment of settlements that would be the hub of the Republic's presence in these regions. The establishment of the uranium mining colony was a high point of this campaign. The colony was built close to rich mineral resources, and it served as a focal point for the Republic's industrial ambitions. The minerals mined were shipped out through new port cities, enriching the industries of the Republic and securing its place in global commerce. These ports helped the economy expand and also showed how powerful the Republic was.

[u]Northern Expansion and Border Disputes[/u]

To the north, the Oceanice Republic targeted lands that were politically split and underdeveloped. They claimed to take these territories to restore stability and development, but this was usually a matter of imposing military power and forcing people to adapt. Expansion northward also suited the ideology of the Republic, as fascist and nationalist rhetoric framed these moves as a means of unifying and enhancing adjacent territories under their rule. But the reality of these campaigns was far harder. Local citizens were frequently compelled to abandon their homes, and those who opposed them were brutally punished. Uniting these regions together brought with it new issues, such as managing disputes and coping with differences in society and culture. The most contentious part of this expansion was the treatment of the non-human societies, specifically the human-like species and other intelligent beings. As the Republic expanded, these communities became viewed as problems for its vision of a cohesive and equal society. The majority were placed in internment camps, where there were poor conditions and restricted freedoms.

The policies of the Republic towards the non-human communities were shaped by a combination of pragmatic necessity and ideological bias. While the camps were initially justified as a means to establish order, they soon became tools of assimilation. Educational programs, propaganda, and restrictive legislation were implemented to transform the communities into citizens loyal to the Republic. Yet, despite all these efforts, non-human communities remained segregated, occupying the lower rungs of a hierarchical class system that demanded human dominance.

The land gained from 1910 to 1915 produced profound changes in the economy. New lands opened up a tremendous amount of natural resources and manpower, which helped to build industries and infrastructure. Southern and northern cities and ports were turned into busy trade centers, which linked the Republic to the world markets and boosted its economic power. The state changed to meet the demands of ruling a larger area. They consolidated centralized authority and built new systems to ensure better governance. While these changes made the Republic well capable of dealing with its expansion, they also reinforced authoritarian practices, prioritizing order and efficiency at the cost of democratic ideals. This centralization of authority intensified social inequality as the human elite enjoyed the majority of the benefits of expansion.

Legacy of Expansion The years that followed the 1910-1915 expansion are years of success and results. The Oceanic Republic came out as a stronger nation and greater force in global politics during these years, with a booming economy and greater visibility in the world. However, this success came at the expense of the marginalized community and the environment, both of which suffered as a result of hasty industrialization and exploitation of resources. The class structure of the time still affects how people view the Republic today. There has been an attempt to make up for the past, like reparations and policies of integration, which have had limited success but remain controversial. Politically, this expansion led to a stronger central state and a concern with national power, values that still shape the politics and goals of the Republic. Looking back at this era, the Oceanice Republic has to deal with the contrast of its past as a conqueror of lands and its desire for a more inclusive and equal future. By embracing the problematic elements of its past, the Republic can work towards creating a society that respects its diverse origins and works to end the disparities that still exist.[/i][/spoiler] [nation]Cordone Roleplay Bureau[/nation]

[quote=dhornaper;59774259][B]The Beginning of a Military Coup[/b]

As President Kourosh is away in Hydronia, General Fereydun Khan meets with his colonels for an upcoming military review.

He had spent several months privately and secretly persuading his colonels and some of his majors of the necessity of a coup, to overthrow a governmental system that had been keeping the country's potential back through heavy handed bureaucracy and which had been meddling incessantly in the military, slashing it's funding and introducing "oversight" committees to watch over actions of generals.

Now, he uses this pre-planned meeting as an opportunity to confirm his coup and bring alongside his officers without arousing the suspicion of the country's Directorate of Intelligence.

He sits at the head of the table and recites his grievances against the government, starting off by mentioning how his troops were underpaid and unprepared due to constant budget cuts and then listing off other objections. He then concludes that the current government isn't fit to continue ruling and they must act to set the country's course straight.

He then says that they will all have their say on whether they agree or not, with his colonels seated to his right and going around the table, descending down the hierarchy to the majors. Colonel Farrokhzhad, the first colonel and a co-conspirator, makes a show of pondering for a few moments before agreeing. To his right, Colonel Jamshid, another co-conspirator, agrees too. All four Colonels, being conspirators, agree to the coup. The first major and non-conspirator, Major Siamak, agrees. Following him, all majors agree.

With all of his assembled officers agreeing, he issues commands that they're to follow at nightfall. As most are stationed outside of the capital, they're to watch for a counter-coup and blockade any approaching loyalist forces while minimising thhe risk of escalation. Colonel Jamshid, whose forces are stationed inside the capital will be the force that decides the outcome of the coup. General Fereydun will personally command part of his forces to guarantee the coup's success.[/quote]

[quote=alkiragunya;59767781][SpoILeR=Legacy and plannings, Arc of Lost Totem Chap. 7]
[b][i]WARARARARARARARAH[/i][/b]
Sua gargalhada era assustadora ao mesmo tempo que também ecoava pelos ouvidos de Dulbara, aquele era o espírito de Warrigal em seu sonho, sua figura era intangível, feita de puro fogo alaranjado, ele circulou com suas chamas Dulbara e passou a mão em sua cabeça, de com um sorriso mesmo e som crepitante ele começou a dizer.
[i]aaaaaaaaaaaaah vamos lá, olhe para você, seu espírito queima, mas não é por orgulho.....Eu vejo.[/i]
Warrigal se dissipou por um momento breve e ressurgiu flutuante no ar com a mão no queixo, pensante ele começou:
[i]....É algo mais profundo que um mero orgulho clânico, seu espírito arde, por algo que vai além de um mero "orgulho", mas oque é isso?[/i]
O "imperador" aproxima o próprio rosto, e deixa o resto do corpo para trás, deixando apenas sua cabeça de labaredas a frente de Warrigal.
[i]MAS, eu não posso contar, iria arruinar a surpresa.[/i]
Ele reúne a cabeça com o restante do corpo e toca com o dedo indicador na testa de Dulbara.
[i]Você saberá quando a hora chegar, será mais cedo ou mais tarde, depende unicamente de você, seu destino não é viver a minha sombra, Dulbara, seu destino é grandioso![/i]
Warrigal se afasta,  seu corpo se torna mais...físico, ou próximo disso, seu rosto tinha traços típicos, mas, marcantes, seu olho brilhava em cor de fogo, mas, aquele sorriso, era o mais marcante, parecia desafiador, mas também largo e acolhedor, seu corpo tinha cicatrizes e tatuagens clânicas, e seus braços tinham labaredas de fogo brilhantes.
[i]Mas, como....como eu iria me comparar a sua...grandiosidade...?[/i]
Dulbara gaguejou, em resposta, Warrigal se manteve sorridente, e falou com uma voz, meio crepitante:
[i]Warhahah, eu nunca precisei me basear em alguém mesmo nosso clã tendo mais de mil anos de história quando eu nasci, eu criei meu próprio legado por conta, oque impede você, 300 anos após minha morte de fazer o mesmo?[/i]
[i]Eu....não sei.[/i]
Warrigal se aproximou, em passos lentos, mas ritmados, ele pôs a mão direita sob a cabeça de Dulbara.
[i]Nós só morremos quando esquecidos, faça feitos lendários, e você não morrerá, e com isso, a vida eterna alcançará, treine mais duro, a vida eventualmente lhe ensinará.[/i]
Warrigal piscou de leve para Dulbara, o qual respondeu, com certa emoção:
[i]Eu...entendo, mas...como[/i].
[i]Não tenha medo de pedir a outros para lhe treinarem, isso não lhe torna fraco pedir ajuda, oque lhe faz fraco é se achar forte, e assim achar que não precisa da ajuda dos outros.[/i]
[i]Eu...entendo, Imperador[/i].
Warrigal não respondeu, apenas fechou os olhos e sorriu. 
Dulbara acordou.
Era noite já, a luz lunar banhava Towurunga, Yumdahri estava sentada ao lado da rede de Dulbara, ela tomava uma bebida de sementes de Ngarrana(uma fruta cujas sementes podem ser trituradas e colocadas na água para gerar uma espécie de "café", aumenta energia), ao fundo Ngarrajin estava reclinado na porta do Gunya com a perna apoiada na estrutura do abrigo e a outra no solo.
[i]Finalmente acordou, você dormiu o dia todo![/i]
Yumdahri começou anunciando, Dulbara se levantou, estava nu da cintura pra cima, Yumdahri o empurrou de volta para se deitar.
[i]CALME, ainda tenho que tirar as comprensas de você.[/i]
Ela disse removendo as folhas de Yidi do peito de Dulbara, e entregou a ele um manto para se cobrir, ele se levantou meio tonto ainda, então agradeceu:
[i]Muito obrigado.[/i]
[i]Não tem de que.[/i]
Yumdahri respondeu,  já tomando outro gole de seu "café" ela se levantou também e saiu. Colocando o manto, mas indo até os ombros, não conseguia deixar de mostrar sua tatuagem de dingo, foi até Ngarrajin e o perguntou:
[i]Ei...mercador, onde tá o resto do pessoal?[/i]
Rajin apontou para o centro de Towurunga, ao redor da fogueira o conselho se reunia.
[i]Obrigado...[/i]
Dulbara respondeu, e então foi andando até lá, ainda meio desnorteado por ter acordado ainda a pouco tempo, Ngarrajin olhou para Dulbara saindo e falou em voz baixa:
[i]De nada...[/i]
[i]Tava bom o sono, dingu?[/i]
Tjarrampa brincou, Dulbara respondeu dando uma risada leve:
[i][b]Kyakyakya[/b], ah, sim Rampa(Apelido de Tjarrampa)[/i].
Rampa sorriu, e então o Dingu se sentou ao redor da fogueira.
Balunji que estava falando antes, continuou.
[i]Como ia dizendo, nós temos 2 fragmentos, traseira e corcova, e os dois estão com Ngarrajin, e o inimigo aparenta ter os outros dois restantes, cabeça e dianteira.[/i]
Kambilla levantou a mão em pergunta, ele parecia ansioso.
[i]E como podemos derrotar ele?[/i]
Antes de poder responder, Rajin surgiu por trás, Tjar murmurou.
[i]Você e suas entradas dramáticas.[/i]
Ngarrajin então corrigiu Balunji e Kambilla.
[i]Não é "ele", são "eles".[/i]
O mercador deu um chute leve para chamar atenção de Tjarrampa, que em resposta disse:
[i]Pouco antes da nuvem de areia dele se dissipar, vimos outras figuras nos observando nas areias, eles estavam cobertos totalmente por mantos, se escondendo propositalmente, há mais de uma pessoa envolvida, isso é certo.[/i]
Balunji pôs a mão no queixo, e pensou, [i]hmm, isso é, uma opção viável, ao mesmo tempo, interessante.[/i]
Kialja foi a primeira a fala no entanto.
[i]Então estamos lidando com uma ameaça maior que pensávamos.[/i]
[i]EU TENHO UMA PROPOSTA![/i]
Amarunga, até então quieto começou falando, e então continuou:
[i]Eu posso usar meu Warlutja para me camuflar e espionar o inimigo[/i].
Ele sugeriu, aparentemente o conselho aprovou a idéia.
[i]E como saberiam onde eles estão?[/i]
Ngarrajin os surpreendeu com a pergunta, realmente, eles não sabiam onde estava o clã Purinina e seus descendentes abrigados, Wurtalpa do clã Kipara então decidiu dar sua própria proposta.
[i]Se eles realizaram o ritual de fusão totêmica em Nariburu, é seguro dizer que eles estão lá.[/i]
[i]Realmente...[/i]
Balunji concordou, com a idéia, e apontou para Amarunga.
[i]Lagarto(Amarunga, você irá de manhã se infiltrar em Nariburu, e de lá trará as informações necessárias que conseguir, é essencial sua missão.[/i]
[i]Vamos também preparar para nós mesmos irmos depois, afinal, assim que Amarunga chegar já estaremos prontos para ir![/i]
Kialja respondeu.
[i]Ah, sim, claro...[/i]
[i]Bem, está ficando tarde já, e meus olhos já estão ficando pesados...vamos dormir e definir tudo amanhã.[/i]
Balunji finalizou, ao terminar lançou um bocejo, todos concordaram, menos Dulbara, não por ter alguma questão ou proposta, apenas por ter dormido o dia inteiro. 
[i]Eu deveria lhe agradecer por manter o totem seguro...muito obrigado por isso, não sei como agradecer.[/i]
Kambilla disse à Ngarrajin, lhe dando um sorriso amigável, Rajin respondeu com outro sorriso, e um baixo, mas audível:
[i]Não precisa.[/i]
------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSLATION:
 [b][i]WARARARARARARARAH[/i][/b]
His laughter was frightening at the same time that it also echoed in Dulbara's ears, that was the spirit of Warrigal in his dream, his figure was intangible, made of pure orange fire, he circled Dulbara with his flames and passed his hand over his head, with a smile and a crackling sound he began to say. [i]aaaaaaaaaaaaah come on, look at you, your spirit burns, but it's not out of pride.....I see.[/i]
Warrigal dissipated for a brief moment and resurfaced floating in the air with his hand on his chin, thoughtfully he began:
[i]....It's something deeper than mere clan pride, your spirit burns, for something that goes beyond mere "pride", but what is that?[/i]
The "emperor" brings his own face closer, and leaves the rest of his body behind, leaving only his head of flames in front of Warrigal.
[i]BUT, I can't tell, it would ruin the surprise.[/i]
He brings his head together with the rest of his body and touches Dulbara's forehead with his index finger. [i]You will know when the time comes, it will be sooner or later, it depends solely on you, your destiny is not to live in my shadow, Dulbara, your destiny is great![/i]
Warrigal moves away, his body becomes more... physical, or close to it, his face had typical but striking features, his eyes shone the color of fire, but that smile was the most striking, it seemed defiant, but also wide and welcoming, his body had scars and clan tattoos, and his arms had bright flames of fire. [i]But, how....how could I compare myself to your...greatness...?[/i]
Dulbara stuttered, in response, Warrigal kept smiling, and spoke with a crackling voice:
[i]Warhahah, I never needed to base myself on anyone even though our clan had more than a thousand years of history when I was born, I created my own legacy on my own, what stops you, 300 years after my death, from doing the same?[/i]
[i]I....don't know.[/i]
Warrigal approached, with slow but rhythmic steps, he placed his right hand under Dulbara's head. [i]We only die when forgotten, do legendary deeds, and you will not die, and with that, eternal life will reach, train harder, life will eventually teach you.[/i]
Warrigal winked slightly at Dulbara, who replied, with some emotion:
[i]I...understand, but...how[/i].
[i]Don't be afraid to ask others to train you, that doesn't make you weak to ask for help, what makes you weak is thinking you are strong, and thus thinking you don't need the help of others.[/i]
[i]I...understand, Emperor[/i].
Warrigal didn't answer, he just closed his eyes and smiled.
Dulbara woke up.
It was already night, the moonlight bathed Towurunga, Yumdahri was sitting next to Dulbara's hammock, she was drinking a drink made from Ngarrana seeds (a fruit whose seeds can be crushed and placed in water to create a kind of "coffee", which increases energy), in the background Ngarrajin was reclining at the door of the Gunya with his leg resting on the structure of the shelter and the other on the ground.
[i]Finally you're awake, you've been sleeping all day![/i]
Yumdahri began announcing, Dulbara stood up, he was naked from the waist up, Yumdahri pushed him back to lie down. [i]CALM DOWN, I still have to take the compresses off you.[/i]
She said, removing the Yidi leaves from Dulbara's chest, and handed him a cloak to cover himself. He stood up, still a little dizzy, and thanked him:
[i]Thank you very much.[/i]
[i]You're welcome.[/i]
Yumdahri replied, already taking another sip of her "coffee", she also stood up and left. Putting on the cloak, but going down to her shoulders, she couldn't help but show her dingo tattoo, she went to Ngarrajin and asked him:
[i]Hey...merchant, where are the rest of the people?[/i]
Rajin pointed to the center of Towurunga, around the fire the council was meeting. [i]Thank you...[/i]
Dulbara replied, and then walked over there, still a little disoriented from having woken up just a short time ago. Ngarrajin looked at Dulbara leaving and spoke in a low voice:
[i]You're welcome...[/i]
[i]Was your sleep good, dingu?[/i]
Tjarrampa joked, Dulbara replied with a light laugh:
[i][b]Kyakyakya[/b], oh, yes Rampa (Tjarrampa's nickname)[/i].
Rampa smiled, and then Dingu sat down around the fire.
Balunji, who was speaking before, continued.
[i]As I was saying, we have 2 fragments, rear and hump, and both are with Ngarrajin, and the enemy seems to have the other two remaining, head and front.[/i]
Kambilla raised his hand in question, he seemed anxious. [i]And how can we defeat him?[/i]
Before he could answer, Rajin appeared from behind, Tjar muttered.
[i]You and your dramatic entrances.[/i]
Ngarrajin then corrected Balunji and Kambilla.
[i]It's not "him", it's "them".[/i]
The merchant gave a light kick to get Tjarrampa's attention, who in response said:
[i]Just before his sand cloud dissipated, we saw other figures watching us in the sands, they were completely covered by cloaks, purposefully hiding, there is more than one person involved, that's for sure.[/i]
Balunji put his hand on his chin, and thought, [i]hmm, that's a viable option, at the same time, interesting.[/i]
Kialja was the first to speak however.
[i]So we are dealing with a greater threat than we thought.[/i]
[i]I HAVE A PROPOSAL![/i]
Amarunga, until then quiet, began to speak, and then continued:
[i]I can use my Warlutja to camouflage myself and spy on the enemy[/i].
He suggested, apparently the council approved the idea.
[i]And how would they know where they are?[/i]
Ngarrajin surprised them with the question, really, they did not know where the Purinina clan and their sheltered descendants were, Wurtalpa of the Kipara clan then decided to give his own proposal.
[i]If they performed the totemic fusion ritual in Nariburu, it is safe to say that they are there.[/i]
[i]Indeed...[/i]
Balunji agreed, with the idea, and pointed to Amarunga. [i]Lizard (Amarunga, you will infiltrate Nariburu in the morning, and from there you will bring back the necessary information you can, your mission is essential.[/i]
[i]Let's also prepare ourselves to go later, after all, as soon as Amarunga arrives we will be ready to go![/i]
Kialja replied.
[i]Oh, yes, of course...[/i]
[i]Well, it's getting late already, and my eyes are already getting heavy...let's sleep and define everything tomorrow.[/i]
Balunji finished, when he finished he yawned, everyone agreed, except Dulbara, not because he had any question or proposal, just because he had slept the whole day.
[i]I should thank you for keeping the totem safe...thank you very much for that, I don't know how to thank you.[/i]
Kambilla said to Ngarrajin, giving him a friendly smile, Rajin replied with another smile, and a low but audible:
[i]No need.[/i]

[i]Eu perdi para um dedo, UM [u]DEDO[/u], ENTENDE?![/i]
Gillut apontou para Tjilpi o dedo indicador, o corvo apenas abaixou a mão do paciente, com calma falou:
[i]Se não tivesse sido tão arrogante isso não teria acontecido você sabe.[/i]
Dulbara, que estava deitado na outra rede, não por precisar, mas apenas pois queria, falou.
[i]Hmph, você também foi derrotado não pode falar de mim...[/i]
Gillut se defendeu, em seguida, Dulbara o respondeu.
[i]Huh, pelo menos não perdi para [b]UM[/b] dedo.[/i]
[i]E EU...[/i]
[i]Pelo amor de Waadang se acalmem, vocês dois foram feridos em batalha e agora estão vendo quem foi mais humilhado...VOCÊS DOIS FORAM![/i]
Tjilpi demanda silêncio, já estava cansado de ouvir as brigas dos dois, eles se calaram, exceto Gillut que murmurou apenas para si:
[i]Eu ainda vou vencer aquele cara.[/i]
Amarunga estava pegando um camelo para viajem, ele não carregava muito, apenas suas vestes e uma bolsa para suprimentos, ele se despediu dizendo:
[i]Eu logo retornarei com notícias deles.[/i]
Amarunga começou a ir em direção de Nariburu, o plano era simples, mas decisivo, ele chegou a Nariburu, lá fora haviam algumas rochas, algumas com símbolos esculpidos de diabos da tasmânia e camelos, Amarunga silenciosamente os pegou e pôs nas vestes.
[i]Isso parece importante, ou pelo menos, útil.[/i] ao pôr uma das pedras nas mãos sentiu um pequeno latejamento de dentro da rocha, ele imediatamente reconheceu [i]EXPLOSIVO![/i]
E jogou a rocha na entrada da caverna, várias pedras desmoronaram e taparam a entrada, Amarunga ficou pálido por ter chamado atenção demais.
[i]Ora ora ora, veja só, uma lagartixa curiosa querendo ver onde não deve. [/i]
Uma figura zombou lá de cima, ele apontou diretamente para Amarunga, ele tinha uma máscara branca com olhos fechados negros e um sorriso sutil, a máscara era branca e por trás dela ele usava um capuz terroso, suas vestes eram uma túnica marrom amarelada batida, suas mãos tinham luvas brancas empoeiradas, e na cintura tinha um cinto de couro de serpente que tinha várias machadinhas.
[i]Procurando meu mestre ora? Pois bem, saiba que Tjuwungu NÃO está aqui...[/i]
Amarunga estava nervoso, ele olhou para o homem e tentou aumentar o tom de voz para parecer severo:
[i]QUEM É VOCÊ, e como sabe que estava aqui?[/I]
[i]Ohohoho, vocês conselheiros parecem esquecer de uma coisa, toda magia deixa rastros, eu só segui os seus, a propósito, que rude de minha parte não me apresentar, me chamo Munderro, aprendiz de Tjuwungu, o mesmo que os atacou há 2 dias, sim o mesmo que reconstruiu o totem Purinina com pedaços do Murkitilpa. [/i]
Munderro falou em um tom calmo e relaxado, mas Amarunga não esperou o purinina dizer mais nada, apenas atacou, levantando várias rochas próximas e as jogando contra Munderro, o qual desviou de forma fluída e elegante, como se estivesse nem tentando.
[i]Ohoho que rude, pois bem então, deixe eu me apresentar.[/i]
Munderro pôs as mãos na cintura e então saltou, uma aura negra dominou sua mão e o machado que suas mãos estavam sobre.
Amarunga se preparou em uma postura defensiva, transformando seu corpo em pedrapara blindagem, o purinina lançou uma das machadinhas contra Amarunga, ela rebateu na pele rochosa e caiu no chão.
[i]Oh, que tolice que a minha, esqueci disso...pois bem, não tenho muito tempo para lutar com você, vamos terminar isso logo.[/i]
Munderro sorriu por trás de sua máscara, ele então disse enquanto passava o braço sobre a testa:
[i]Lâmina degenerada.[/i]
Seu antebraço brilhou em uma aura escura afiada que ia até a ponta de sua mão desde o cotovelo, ele saltou para Amarunga que bloqueou o ataque com os dois braços, mas logo sentiu sua armadura se quebrando.
 [i]O...oque[/i]
Ele gaguejou, em resposta, Munderro levantou os braços como se declamasse algo:
[i]Lâmina degenerada, uma técnica sombria, que consiste em canalizar a energia no antebraço como uma lâmina, é capaz de cortar muitas coisas diferentes, incluindo, outras formas de magia.[/i]
Ele apontou para Amarunga, que perguntou:
[i]E por que você me diria isso?![/i]
Munderro apenas deu de ombros e respondeu:
[i]Pois, ora, não é essa sua missão? A minha era apenas de patrulhar, não impedir espionagem ou coleta de informações.[/i]
Ele então suspirou e preparou-se em postura de luta, parecia meio, relaxado demais, Amarunga decidiu atacar, transformando a mão em rocha, o Purinina segurou seu soco em frente à sua máscara e disse.
[i]Lento demais, tente denovo.[/i]
E foi outro soco, dessa vez também bloqueado, na barriga, ele se recuou com uma acrobacia, e novamente o desafiou a atacar, novamente, sem fazer o primeiro ataque.
[i]Oque você quer.[/i]
Amarunga rugiu, Munderro riu novamente.
[i]Ohoho, seus primeiros dois ataques foram absolutamente vergonhosos, estou lhe dando outra chance de atacar e se redimir.[/i]
Amarunga novamente avançou, com um soco mais cheio de energia, Munderro porém dessa vez desviou, ágil e elegante, retirou um machado maior que estava escondido em suas costas e então disse.
[i]Muito bom devo dizer, é oque espera do poder de um conselheiro, PARTIÇÃO ATTERRADORA![/i]
Ele golpeou o ar em direção a Amarunga que criou a projeção de um "slash" vermelho , ele arregalou os olhos de surpresa, e então foi atingido e atirado contra um obelisco rochoso, que caiu sobre ele, mas antes de cair, ativou Warlutja, e então escalou as rochas para fazer um ataque surpresa.
[i]Onde está...lagartixa, onde está.[/i]
Ele zombou procurando, mas então Amarunga o atacou por trás, pelas costas com um soco na lateral de suas costelas, Munderro foi jogado, mas se recuperou rápido.
[i]Agh, que deselegante...mas um bom uso de sua técnica...  [/i]
Então avançou novamente, agora com o machado imbuído em energia escura, Amarunga agiu rápido e formou uma clava de rocha das mãos e ambas armas se colidiram, criando um impacto devastador para ambos, que foram jogados para trás, Amarunga pensou por um momento:
[i]Ele é poderoso demais, mas o tempo está passando, seria sensato ativar Warlutja e recuar.[/i]
Do outro lado, o adversário pensou:
[i]Oooh, ele é poderoso, tem a técnica, e sabe a manusear...mais ou menos, ele não vai terminar essa luta, se não recuar agora irá o fazer logo em outra oportunidade, isso não será um problema no entanto, é sensato recuar agora, 1 voltar para aquele velho(Tjuwungu) logo se não ele ficará mais irritante do que já é, e 2, meu braço já está puxando, eu poderia usar novamente a lâmina degenerada, mas seria um custo desnecessário, hm, já sei.
[/i][b]dissipação[/b]. 
Munderro disse, então uma nuvem de areia o engolindo, após ela se desfazer, já não estava mais lá, Amarunga não perdeu tempo, ativou Warlutja e rastejou de volta a estrada, voltando a Towurunga, cansado e meio cambaleante, mas ainda são, ele chegou para Balunji e falou, com o tom de voz arrastado:
[i]Eles já saíram...trouxe alguns objetos do ritual...e Tjuwungu, o nome do inimigo, não está sozinho...Munderro é o nome de outro seguidor...[/i]
Balunji segurou Amarunga, mesmo que não tivesse caindo, queria precaver, ele respondeu:
[i]Eu entendo, agora, descanse.[/i]
----------------------------------------
[i]I lost to a finger, [u]ONE [/u]FINGER, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?![/i]
Gillut pointed his index finger at Tjilpi, the crow just lowered the patient's hand and calmly said:
[i]If you hadn't been so arrogant this wouldn't have happened, you know.[/i]
Dulbara, who was lying in the other hammock, not because he needed to, but just because he wanted to, spoke.
[i]Hmph, you were also defeated, you can't talk about me...[/i]
Gillut defended himself, then Dulbara answered him. [i]Huh, at least I didn't lose to  [b]ONE[/b] finger[/i]
[i]AND ME...[/i]
[i]For the love of Waadang, calm down, you two were injured in battle and now you're seeing who was more humiliated...YOU TWO WERE![/i]
Tjilpi demanded silence, he was tired of hearing the two fight, they fell silent, except Gillut who muttered only to himself:
[i]I'm still going to beat that guy.[/i]
Amarunga was taking a camel for the trip, he didn't carry much, just his clothes and a bag for supplies, he said goodbye saying:
[i]I'll be back soon with news of them.[/i]
Amarunga started heading towards Nariburu, the plan was simple, but decisive, he arrived at Nariburu, outside there were some rocks, some with carved symbols of Tasmanian devils and camels, Amarunga silently picked them up and put them in his clothes.
[i]This seems important, or at least useful.[/i] As he put one of the stones in his hands he felt a small throbbing inside the rock, he immediately recognized it [i]EXPLOSIVE![/i]
And he threw the rock at the entrance of the cave, several stones crumbled and blocked the entrance, Amarunga turned pale for having drawn too much attention.
[i]Well well well, look at that, a curious lizard wanting to see where it shouldn't.[/i]
A figure mocked from above, he pointed directly at Amarunga, he had a white mask with closed black eyes and a subtle smile, the mask was white and behind it he wore an earthy hood, his clothes were a worn yellowish brown tunic, his hands had dusty white gloves, and around his waist he had a snakeskin belt that had several small axes.
[i]Looking for my master now? Well, know that Tjuwungu is NOT here...[/i]
Amarunga was nervous, he looked at the man and tried to raise his voice to sound stern:
[i]WHO ARE YOU, and how do you know I was here?[/i]
[i]Ohohoho, you counselors seem to forget one thing, all magic leaves traces, I only followed yours, by the way, how rude of me not to introduce myself, my name is Munderro, apprentice of Tjuwungu, the same one who attacked them 2 days ago, yes, the same one who rebuilt the Purinina totem with pieces of Murkitilpa.[/i]
Munderro spoke in a calm and relaxed tone, but Amarunga did not wait for the purinina to say anything else, he just attacked, lifting several nearby rocks and throwing them at Munderro, who dodged them fluidly and elegantly, as if he was not even trying. [i]Ohoho how rude, well then, let me introduce myself.[/i]
Munderro put his hands on his waist and then jumped, a black aura dominated his hand and the axe that his hands were on.
Amarunga prepared himself in a defensive posture, transforming his body into stone for armor, the purinina threw one of the small axes at Amarunga, it bounced off the rocky skin and fell to the ground.
[i]Oh, how foolish of me, I forgot about that... well, I don't have much time to fight you, let's finish this quickly.[/i]
Munderro smiled behind his mask, he then said as he passed his arm over his forehead:
[i]Degenerate blade.[/i]
His forearm shone in a sharp dark aura that went all the way to the tip of his hand from the elbow, he jumped towards Amarunga who blocked the attack with both arms, but soon felt his armor breaking. [i]W...what?[/i]
He stuttered, in response, Munderro raised his arms as if declaiming something:
[i]Degenerate blade, a dark technique, which consists of channeling energy in the forearm like a blade, is capable of cutting many different things, including other forms of magic.[/i]
He pointed at Amarunga, who asked:
[i]And why would you tell me that?![/i]
Munderro just shrugged and replied:
[i]Well, isn't that your mission? Mine was just to patrol, not prevent espionage or information gathering.[/i]
He then sighed and prepared himself in a fighting stance, he seemed a little too relaxed, Amarunga decided to attack, turning his hand into rock, Purinina held his punch in front of his mask and said.
[i]Too slow, try again.[/i]
And it was another punch, this time also blocked, in the belly, he retreated with an acrobatic acrobatics, and again challenged him to attack, again, without making the first attack.
[i]What do you want.[/i]
Amarunga roared, Munderro laughed again.
[i]Ohoho, your first two attacks were absolutely shameful, I'm giving you another chance to attack and redeem yourself.[/i]
Amarunga again advanced, with a punch fuller of energy, Munderro however this time dodged it, agile and elegant, he removed a larger axe that was hidden in his back and then said.
[i]Very good I must say, it's what you expect from the power of a counselor, TERRIFYING PARTITION![/i]
He struck the air towards Amarunga that created the projection of a red "slash", he widened his eyes in surprise, and then was hit and thrown against a rocky obelisk, which fell on him, but before falling, he activated Warlutja, and then climbed the rocks to make a surprise attack.
[i]Where is... lizard, where is it.[/i]
He mocked searching, but then Amarunga attacked him from behind, from behind with a punch to the side of his ribs, Munderro was thrown, but recovered quickly. [i]Agh, how inelegant... but a good use of his technique... [/i]
Then he advanced again, now with the axe imbued with dark energy, Amarunga acted quickly and formed a rock club in his hands and both weapons collided, creating a devastating impact for both, who were thrown back, Amarunga thought for a moment:
[i]He is too powerful, but time is running out, it would be wise to activate Warlutja and retreat.[/i]
On the other side, the opponent thought:
[i]Oooh, he is powerful, he has the technique, and he knows how to handle it... more or less, he will not finish this fight, if he does not retreat now he will do it soon another time, that will not be a problem however, it is wise to retreat now, 1. go back to that old man (Tjuwungu) soon or he will become more annoying than he already is, and 2. my arm is already pulling, I could use the degenerate blade again, but it would be a cost unnecessary, hm, I know.
[/i][b]dissipation[/b].
Munderro said, then a cloud of sand swallowed him, after it dispersed, he was no longer there, Amarunga wasted no time, activated Warlutja and crawled back to the road, returning to Towurunga, tired and half staggering, but still healthy, he arrived at Balunji and spoke, with a drawn-out tone of voice:
[i]They have already left... I brought some ritual objects... and Tjuwungu, the name of the enemy, is not alone... Munderro is the name of another follower...[/i]
Balunji held Amarunga, even though he was not falling, he wanted to be careful, he replied:
[i]I understand, now, rest.[/i]

[quote=dhornaper;59774259][B]The Beginning of a Military Coup[/b]

As President Kourosh is away in Hydronia, General Fereydun Khan meets with his colonels for an upcoming military review.

He had spent several months privately and secretly persuading his colonels and some of his majors of the necessity of a coup, to overthrow a governmental system that had been keeping the country's potential back through heavy handed bureaucracy and which had been meddling incessantly in the military, slashing it's funding and introducing "oversight" committees to watch over actions of generals.

Now, he uses this pre-planned meeting as an opportunity to confirm his coup and bring alongside his officers without arousing the suspicion of the country's Directorate of Intelligence.

He sits at the head of the table and recites his grievances against the government, starting off by mentioning how his troops were underpaid and unprepared due to constant budget cuts and then listing off other objections. He then concludes that the current government isn't fit to continue ruling and they must act to set the country's course straight.

He then says that they will all have their say on whether they agree or not, with his colonels seated to his right and going around the table, descending down the hierarchy to the majors. Colonel Farrokhzhad, the first colonel and a co-conspirator, makes a show of pondering for a few moments before agreeing. To his right, Colonel Jamshid, another co-conspirator, agrees too. All four Colonels, being conspirators, agree to the coup. The first major and non-conspirator, Major Siamak, agrees. Following him, all majors agree.

With all of his assembled officers agreeing, he issues commands that they're to follow at nightfall. As most are stationed outside of the capital, they're to watch for a counter-coup and blockade any approaching loyalist forces while minimising thhe risk of escalation. Colonel Jamshid, whose forces are stationed inside the capital will be the force that decides the outcome of the coup. General Fereydun will personally command part of his forces to guarantee the coup's success.[/quote]

[B]Nightfall[/b]

Fereydun Khan wears a trenchcoat, hiding his general's uniform as he makes his way to one of Colonel Jamshid's company's barracks. When he arrives, he takes off his trenchcoat at the front entrance and identifies himself before stating he has an urgent message to personally deliver to Colonel Jamshid. The soldier unlocks the gate and lets him in.

He makes his way to the barracks' head office where Colonel Jamshid, Major Siamak, and their NCOs are assembled. He at once ordered them to assemble the company on the parade field. After the company was assembled, he announced to the enlisted soldiers that they are part of a larger coup attempt involving all units in the capital. He then gave the men a choice: they could participate or, if they objected, they could stand aside.

After a short moment where no one objected, he turned to Major Siamak and informed him of the locations his men were to occupy. They were to occupy the state broadcaster, the Presidential palace, and the Majlis building. He turned towards Colonel Jamshid and ordered him to get his other units to occupy the airport, the offices for the Ministry of Defence and the Directorate of Intelligence, preapre to shut off internet access across the country, occupy the other major broadcasters, the police headquarters, and to control the air force base just outside the capital.

With that, Colonel Jamshid set off to issue orders to his other companies and General Fereydun got into an army truck with Major Siamak as they drove their part of the company to the state broadcaster.
